scope: Full-resolution read-only component audit of Christmas, Hanbok, Astronaut
decision: No ready genuine independent moving layer is supplied for these three costumes. Do not ship a cutout that exposes holes. Preserve approved artwork and report missing layers.

safeCurrentUse: Whole-character translate/scale/tilt with sufficient external motion padding; call it whole-character motion
unprovenExperiments: Pinned-root deformation of exposed leaf tips or outer raised sleeve tips may avoid new hidden pixels if every attachment contour remains fixed. Requires separate rendered extrema and actual runtime proof; not approved by this audit and not a complete rigid limb layer.
prohibitedShortcuts: Duplicating an original under the moving part creates double contours
Complement mask with missing body creates a hole
Painting/cloning/inpainting hidden roots changes approved artwork and is outside authorization
Scaling open eyes to a line does not supply clean face or approved eyelids
Using retired orange Pio parts substitutes a different character
stageSource: docs/qa/routimori-growth-stages-2026-10-15/assets/stage1.png through stage4.png are four flattened review illustrations, not costume rigs or compatible layered body sources.
